## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm gate` passes (typecheck, lint, inventory, tests, coverage, builds, size)
- [ ] The Firefox/WebKit survey passes, if this touches components (`docs/verification.md`)
- [ ] A changeset is added if a consumer can see the change (`pnpm changeset`, `.changeset/README.md`)
- [ ] Specs and docs are updated alongside the code
